data.summary: Lennox International (LII) intègre l'IA/ML de manière opérationnelle dans ses produits, opérations ou processus selon son 10-K, sans en faire son coeur d'identité.

evidence.quote: Finally, multiple jurisdictions have either already put in place laws and regulations governing the use of AI, or are considering such laws and regulations.
We face risk of competitive disadvantage if our competitors more effectively use AI to better serve customers, drive internal efficiencies, and/or create new or enhanced products or services.
